svg.title: Степ-ап на высокую платформу — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Unweighted high-platform step-up, full side profile. One tall stable rectangular gym step box, top just under knee height. START lead right foot flat entirely on top, lead knee bent, trailing left foot clearly on floor behind the box. FINISH right foot stays in SAME spot and right leg is straight as athlete stands ON TOP of box, left foot joins the top beside it, torso upright. Keep box identical and draw shoe soles visibly touching top surface, avoid floating shoes or feet disappearing inside box. No weights, rails or steps in between. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
